name: 31434-solodecode-qwen3-14b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-14B as the target, with deepseek-ai/dspark_qwen3_14b_block7 as the DSpark draft. Both are public and ungated. The draft is not substitutable: it is built against this target and carries the confidence head the engine requires to start outside `static` ragged-verify mode.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1 -- one GPU, unsharded.
architecture: Target: Qwen3ForCausalLM, 40 layers, 40 query heads over 8 KV heads (head_dim 128), hidden 5120, intermediate 17408, vocab 151936, bf16, ~29.6 GB of weights. Draft: Qwen3DSparkModel, 5 layers, same hidden size and vocab, `block_size: 7`, bf16, ~6.8 GB.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 40 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, seed 42. Prompts exactly 512 tokens (stdev 0), generations exactly 2048 tokens (stdev 0) with `ignore_eos: true` at `temperature: 0.0`, so every request decodes its full length greedily and prefill is ~2% of a request.
purpose: A 14B writing assistant with a draft model, turning short briefs into 2,000-token answers for one user on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang launch arguments: one H100 serving Qwen3-14B with DSpark speculative decoding.
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser and the engine would then
# run without something this card declares.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-14B
tp-size: 1
trust-remote-code: true

# The draft is not substitutable: without a confidence head the engine refuses to start.
speculative-algorithm: DSPARK
speculative-draft-model-path: deepseek-ai/dspark_qwen3_14b_block7

# fa3 is the Hopper-native pair; the alternative (trtllm_mha + fa4) requires SM100.
attention-backend: fa3
speculative-draft-attention-backend: fa3

# `cuda-graph-backend-prefill` is the current spelling of the deprecated
# `--disable-piecewise-cuda-graph`; both set the same field.
cuda-graph-max-bs-decode: 4
cuda-graph-backend-prefill: disabled

page-size: 1

mem-fraction-static: 0.7

enable-metrics: true
